cases.title: the flow-level fields that matter at run time

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
summary: s
timeout: 30
value:
  same_worker: true
  skip_expr: flow_input.skip
  early_return: a
  cache_ttl: 60
  concurrent_limit: 2
  priority: 1
  preserve_step_tags: true
  flow_env: {B: 1, A: '$var:f/x/v'}
  modules:
    - id: a
      value: {type: identity}

note: The flow fields of OF-16 that the engine reads; queue and placement controls are dropped.
